MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Cheek to Cheek appeals to me because classic vocal duets feel connected to the vocal music I have chosen; it is the one album I would try today.",
    "The vocal harmonies of Peter, Paul and Mary have some appeal, so that suggestion captures part of my interest, although I do not want folk songs today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Mer De Noms, Dirt, Temple Of The Dog, and 10.000 Days lean toward heavy or intense rock, which does not fit the holiday and vocal listening reflected in my choices.",
    "Adele's albums and Earth Wind & Fire do not give me enough of the familiar vocal character I want to make me choose them today.",
    "I cannot connect The Very Best Of to my interests without knowing the artist, so I would skip it rather than assume it is familiar music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat an interest in music albums as enough of a connection, even when their sound and mood differ greatly from what I have chosen.",
    "A recognizable album or a greatest-hits collection is not enough to interest me; the particular voices and style matter more."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my earlier choices were Christmas albums, including repeated interest in The Classic Christmas Album; that shared listening mood deserves more attention.",
    "Those Christmas choices were clustered together in November 2014, while my latest choice was The New Old Fashioned in September 2016; I would not assume I still want only Christmas music.",
    "I rarely choose something unless the connection feels strong, so a loose resemblance such as having vocals is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "Cheek to Cheek captures my interest in classic vocal music, but most suggestions miss the sound and listening mood that would make me choose an album now."
}
